## Load packages for this project

```{r}
install.packages("patchwork")
library(ggprism)
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
library(patchwork)
```

## Import clinical data and visualize raw data

Visualize degrees of off vertical center as a function of time of each patient, then map exercise to colour aesthetics to show level of balance of each patient, treatment and exercise status. This plot type display how "off center' each patient is through time.

The most suitable descriptive statistic to represent how "balanced" a patient is is the mean degrees off vertical orientation.

```{r}
load("data/gait.Rda")

# Convert this table into a tidy "long" data frame:
clean_gait_data <- gait_data %>% pivot_longer(cols = 5:last_col(),
                           names_to = "Time_of_measurement_seconds",
                           values_to = "Degrees_off_vertical_orientation" )

# Then convert values in the column "Times of measurement" into numeric time.
clean_gait_data <- clean_gait_data %>% mutate(Time_of_measurement_seconds = sub("_.*", "", Time_of_measurement_seconds))

# Plot everything
plot_everything <- clean_gait_data %>% 
  ggplot(aes(Time_of_measurement_seconds, Degrees_off_vertical_orientation, colour = treatment, shape = exercise))+
  geom_col()+
  facet_wrap(~donorid)+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )

plot_everything

# Plot old compound
plot_old_compound <- clean_gait_data %>% 
  filter(treatment == "L-DOPA control") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(Time_of_measurement_seconds, Degrees_off_vertical_orientation, fill = exercise))+
  geom_col()+
  guides(fill = "none")+
  facet_wrap(~donorid)+
  labs(title = "L-DOPA")+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = margin(t = 40, r = 60, b = 60, l = 60),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, vjust = 5)
        )

# Plot new compound
plot_new_compound <- clean_gait_data %>% 
  filter(treatment == "New compound") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(Time_of_measurement_seconds, Degrees_off_vertical_orientation, fill = exercise))+
  geom_col()+
  labs(y = "")+
  facet_wrap(~donorid)+
  theme_bw()+
  labs(title = "New compound")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = margin(t = 40, r = 60, b = 60, l = 60),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, vjust = 5)
  )




# Combined two plots into the same figure
plot_grid(plot_old_compound, plot_new_compound)
          
         

  
```

## Plot mean of degrees imbalance against treatment and exercise condition

Whether or not a patient exercise

```{r}



clean_gait_data %>% 
  group_by(donorid, treatment, exercise) %>% 
  summarise(avg_imbalance = mean(sqrt(Degrees_off_vertical_orientation^2))) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(treatment, avg_imbalance, colour = exercise))+
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.3), linewidth = 1)+
  geom_jitter(position = position_dodge(width = 0.3), size = 0.9)+
  theme_classic(base_size = 16)+
  scale_colour_discrete(name = "Exercise status",
                        breaks = c("y", "n"),
                        labels = c("Yes", "No"))+
  labs(x = "Treatment",
       y = "Imbalance (Mean of degrees off vertical centre)")+
  theme(text = element_text(family = "Helvetica", face = "bold"),
        axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 1.3),
        axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 1.3),
        axis.ticks.length = unit(0.1, "inch")
  )
  


```

## Investigate how age affects drug effect, using mean as representative of balance

```{r}
clean_gait_data %>% 
  group_by(donorid, treatment, exercise,age) %>% 
  summarise(avg_imbalance = mean(sqrt(Degrees_off_vertical_orientation^2))) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(age, avg_imbalance, colour = treatment, shape = exercise))+
  geom_point()+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(text = element_text(family = "Helvetica", face = "bold"),
        axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 1.3),
        axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 1.3),
        axis.ticks.length = unit(0.1, "inch")
  )

```

## Investigate how age affects drug effect, using standard deviation as representative of balance

```{r}
clean_gait_data %>% 
  group_by(donorid, treatment, exercise) %>% 
  summarise(avg_imbalance = sd(Degrees_off_vertical_orientation)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(treatment, avg_imbalance, colour = exercise))+
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.3), linewidth = 1)+
  geom_jitter(position = position_dodge(width = 0.3), size = 0.9)+
  theme_bw(base_size = 16)+
  scale_colour_discrete(name = "Exercise status",
                        breaks = c("y", "n"),
                        labels = c("Yes", "No"))+
  labs(x = "Treatment",
       y = "Imbalance (Mean of degrees off vertical centre)",
       title = "Standard deviation")+
  theme(text = element_text(family = "Helvetica", face = "bold"),
        axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 1.3),
        axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 1.3),
        axis.ticks.length = unit(0.1, "inch"),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
        
  )

```
